Game Overview

In Minicars, the core idea is straightforward: race your way through chaotic tracks in Minicars, where each turn is a test of skill and humor. Control a tiny car using just your mouse, navigating agilely between opponents and obstacles. With loose physics and explosive mishaps, every victory feels earned, and every race is a spectacle.
